about.title: The Vicious Family
about.body1: We are a team of passionate Saudi men and women, united by our love for esports.
about.body2: What began as a PUBG Mobile clan has evolved into a powerhouse organization, competing at the highest levels both locally and internationally.
about.body3: In just three years, our journey transformed from a small gaming clan into a recognized esports force. Today, as part of The Vicious family, we strive for excellence across multiple titles, relentlessly pursuing victory and making our mark on the global stage.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: Building a strong esports foundation in the Middle East to expand our fan base while strategically achieving our goals.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To support Saudi Arabia's leadership in esports and Vision 2030's goal of making Riyadh the global esports capital.

inclusion.title: Female Inclusion
inclusion.body: We are championing equality, diversity and inclusion through professional esports, player development and recruitment initiatives.
inclusion.stat1: 65% of Vicious Esports staff are women
inclusion.stat2: Female players compete in 2 of 7 titles
